candidate.educational_objective: Recognize the CMS Hospital VBP Program as a performance-improvement model in which specified quality and cost performance is linked to IPPS payment adjustments.

options.A: The VBP payment adjustment is based only on the number of inpatient services the hospital bills
options.B: The VBP payment adjustment is based only on the hospital's annual operating margin
options.C: Hospital performance on specified quality and cost measures is linked to IPPS payment adjustments
options.D: The VBP payment adjustment is determined only by the hospital's number of licensed beds

candidate.rationale: CMS states that the Hospital VBP Program links hospital performance on quality and cost measures to payments under the Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) and rewards quality rather than simply the quantity of services provided. Therefore C is the best answer. A, B, and D each substitute a single volume, financial, or facility-size variable for the defined quality-and-cost performance framework used by the Hospital VBP Program.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Under the Hospital VBP Program, hospital performance on selected quality and cost measures is linked to IPPS payment adjustments; the program is designed to reward quality rather than merely quantity of services.
candidate.source_locator: Sections 'How does the Hospital VBP Program work?' and introductory program description: hospital performance on quality and cost measures is linked to IPPS; the program rewards quality rather than just quantity of services
